title: Nominal traffic: rover telemetry at five priorities; signed commands, signed telemetry and a heartbeat from Earth; PING replies
summary: All links up, fixed one-way delays only. Rover to Earth: telemetry at all five priorities, a 20000-byte BULK image chunk, a header-only envelope with ACK_REQ, and a Status envelope answering each PING; none of these is signed. Earth to rover: signed commands (Ed25519, and HMAC-SHA-256 for SET_HEATER), signed MCC telemetry (the rover requires a Security frame on every Earth-MCC envelope that has a payload, SPEC-DIGEST A38) and a header-only TTL 0 heartbeat. Signed envelopes travel only from Earth to the rover, so Endpoint B verifies no live signed envelope; it verifies SEC-B-01 only in the offline S7 vectors.

criteria.text: Every rover envelope handed to ION is received at Earth
Every Earth envelope handed to ION is received at the rover
Every received envelope is byte-identical to the envelope handed to ION (SHA-256 of all bytes, 44 header bytes)
The rover executes (logs) each authenticated command once, in order
Each PING is answered and the answer reaches Earth
End-to-end latency between the 1.55 s propagation floor and 3.0 s
TTL 0 envelopes are sent with the 2147483647 s no-expiry bundle lifetime
TTL 0 envelopes sent with that lifetime are delivered
Every send uses the class of service of SPEC-DIGEST 7.5 for its priority
Every bundle source EID matches the Source ID mapping (Rover-Alpha ipn:99.1, Earth-MCC ipn:23.1)
No duplicate or unknown envelope is received
No receiver accepts an envelope older than its TTL

conformance.how: S1-3: header bytes and SHA-256 equal after BPv7 carriage over LTP through the relay

partial: S1-10 shows one ION class of service per priority (SPEC-DIGEST 7.5, docs/MAPPING-PROFILE.md); the demo has one static mapping, with no network state input and no policy version, so a mapping per defined network state is not exercised
one recv record per delivered bundle and one exec record per executed command (S1-4, S1-5)
S1-8, S1-9: TTL 0 envelopes carried with the no-expiry lifetime of the mapping profile (docs/MAPPING-PROFILE.md) and delivered
both receivers parse and CRC-check every envelope of the other implementation (S1-4)
all five priorities sent and received (S1-1, S1-10)
Sequence starts at 1 and increments per envelope at each sender (send records)
one envelope per bundle payload, lifetime from TTL, verbatim extraction, Source ID to EID mapping (S1-3, S1-8, S1-11)
